hostToPanel.purpose: Negotiate the exact protocol before any state is accepted.
Atomically replace the displayed projection of one canonical host state.
Clear displayed activity and require a new monotonic sequence.
Set a bounded global indicator brightness from 0.00 through 0.25.
Prove that the authoritative host link is alive.

panelToHost.purpose: Confirm protocol compatibility and physical capabilities.
Report one debounced physical key transition.
Acknowledge that one complete validated state became visible.
Report a bounded protocol, power, watchdog, or local electrical fault.
Report panel liveness without claiming canonical state authority.

stateConstraints.sequenceRule: strictly increasing after handshake or reset
stateConstraints.applicationRule: validate the complete frame before changing any indicator

faultPolicy.invalidFrame: Reject the frame, preserve the last valid display, emit FAULT.
faultPolicy.incompatibleProtocol: Reject all state frames until a compatible HELLO is received.
faultPolicy.watchdogAction: Enter the visible local fault pattern without synthesizing canonical state.
faultPolicy.recovery: Require a fresh HELLO before accepting another state frame.

prototype.purpose: Reduced bench proof before the 24-key, 56-indicator panel is fabricated.
